title.narrative: Pathways to Economic Inclusion and Self-Reliance of the Refugees and Host Communities in Rwanda through Scaling up Graduation Approach

description.narrative: The main objective of the Graduation Scale Up project is to enable graduation pathway of 1,500 poor and vulnerable households of Refugee and host communities (1,050 Refugee households and 450 Host Communities households) in two refugee hosting districts. The project therefore aims at graduating at least 70% of the 1,500 households out of extreme poverty by 2024.
